description: Vectors, matrices, linear transformations, and their applications

vectors.definition: Quantity with both magnitude and direction; represented as ordered tuple
vectors.notation: Column vector: [x, y, z]ᵀ or bold **v**

matrices.definition: Rectangular array of numbers in rows and columns
matrices.notation: m × n matrix has m rows and n columns

operations.addition: Add corresponding elements; same dimensions required
operations.matrix_mult: AB: (i,j) entry = dot product of row i of A and column j of B; not commutative
operations.inverse: A⁻¹ such that AA⁻¹ = I; exists only for square non-singular matrices
operations.determinant: Scalar value; det(A) ≠ 0 means A is invertible

special_matrices.identity: I; diagonal of 1s, rest 0s; AI = IA = A
special_matrices.orthogonal: QᵀQ = I; rows/columns are orthonormal vectors

systems_of_equations.matrix_form: Ax = b; A is coefficient matrix, x is unknown vector, b is constant vector
systems_of_equations.row_reduction: Gaussian elimination to row echelon form

vector_spaces.definition: Set closed under addition and scalar multiplication
vector_spaces.subspace: Subset of vector space that is itself a vector space
vector_spaces.span: All linear combinations of a set of vectors
vector_spaces.linear_independence: No vector can be written as linear combination of others
vector_spaces.basis: Minimal spanning set; linearly independent vectors that span the space
vector_spaces.dimension: Number of vectors in a basis

eigenvalues_eigenvectors.definition: Av = λv; v is eigenvector, λ is eigenvalue
eigenvalues_eigenvectors.diagonalization: A = PDP⁻¹ where D is diagonal matrix of eigenvalues

linear_transformations.definition: Function T: V → W preserving addition and scalar multiplication
linear_transformations.properties: T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v); T(cu) = cT(u)

applications.machine_learning: Neural networks are sequences of linear transformations + activations
applications.physics: Quantum states as vectors; operators as matrices
